source_title: NORTH FORK MONO CASINO IN MADERA, CA OPENS TODAY AT 3PM OCTOBER 27 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
The Central Valley's newest casino welcomes eager crowds ahead of schedule
LAS VEGAS , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- North Fork Mono Casino officially opened its doors today at 3:00 PM, treating visitors to an unexpected early opening. The new casino resort is managed by Station Casinos LLC ("Station Casinos "), a consolidated subsidiary of Red Rock Resorts, Inc. (NASDAQ: RRR ), in partnership with the North Fork Rancheria of Mono Indians (the "Tribe").
Guests are now experiencing dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, filling the space with natural light, in an elevated and modern design. The casino offers one of the region's largest gaming selections with over 2,400 slots and 40 table games. For players seeking a premium, intimate experience, the casino features an exclusive High Limit Room, complete with 138 slots, 10 table games, a private bar, and its own dedicated cashier.
Complementing the expansive gaming floor is a diverse food and beverage program. With eight dining venues and four distinct bars, there is an option for every taste and occasion. Dining staples include Manzanita Steakhouse, the flagship restaurant, which boasts more than 250 local and international wine labels curated by a master sommelier. It offers true farm-to-table cuisine paired with live piano music and uniquely crafted cocktails from an in-house mixologist. For the ultimate game-day destination, Clubhouse 99 featuring 56 large-screen TVs and more than 20 local and imported beers on tap.
The total all-in project cost remains approximately $750 million.

ABOUT RED ROCK RESORTS Red Rock Resorts, Inc. is a holding company that owns an indirect equity interest in and manages Station Casinos . Station Casinos is the leading provider of gaming, hospitality and entertainment to the residents of Las Vegas, Nevada. Station Casinos ' properties, which are located throughout the Las Vegas valley, are regional entertainment destinations and include various amenities, including numerous restaurants, entertainment venues, movie theaters, bowling and convention/banquet space, as well as traditional casino gaming offerings such as video poker, slot machines, table games, bingo and race and sports wagering. Station Casinos owns and operates Red Rock Casino Resort Spa, Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa Casino , Durango Casino Resort, Palace Station Hotel & Casino , Boulder Station Hotel & Casino , Sunset Station Hotel & Casino , Santa Fe Station Hotel & Casino , Wildfire Rancho, Wildfire Boulder, Wildfire Sunset, Wildfire Valley View, Wildfire Anthem, Wildfire Lake Mead, Wildfire on Fremont and Seventy Six by Station Casinos (North Lamb, Aliante, Union Village, Tropicana, Fort Apache, Park Highlands, and Silverado Ranch). Station Casinos also owns a 50% interest in Barley's Casino & Brewing Company, Wildfire Casino & Lanes and The Greens.
About North Fork Mono Casino North Fork Mono Casino opened October 27, 2026, in the heart of the Central Valley. Conveniently located off Highway 99 in Madera, the resort brings an elevated yet welcoming gaming, dining, and entertainment experience to residents and visitors throughout the region. Developed by the North Fork Rancheria of Mono Indians of California and managed by Station Casinos , the $725 million development represents a significant investment in the Central Valley economy, creating more than 1,500 local jobs across gaming, hospitality, and food and beverage operations. Spanning 264,000 square feet, North Fork Mono Casino features more than 2,400 slot machines, 40 table games, eight dining venues, and four bars, offering guests a dynamic destination for entertainment and leisure.
